result:
I’d make the consequences of power impossible to ignore: anyone whose decisions harm others would immediately, vividly understand the suffering caused.

Most cruelty survives because consequences are abstract, distant, or borne by people the decision-maker never has to face. If that distance collapsed, the world would still have conflict and hard choices—but far less casual damage.
